items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: when you were hired by Atlantic, when you were signed to Atlantic, at least for this one album that Joel Dorn was producing... tell me about the experience of making that album.

ctx.x: Where were you – I know you were in Cleveland – but when you get this call in 1968 or 1969 from Joel Dorn, who’s a producer at Atlantic, how did that all come about?
Yeah. The Source, I’m talking about. The album that became The Source.
